Over the last 20 years, Ares’ success has been driven by our people and our culture. Today, our team is guided by our core values – Collaborative, Responsible, Entrepreneurial, Self-Aware, Trustworthy – and our purpose to be a catalyst for shared prosperity and a better future. Through our recruitment, career development and employee-focused programming, we are committed to fostering a welcoming and inclusive work environment where high-performance talent of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can build careers within this exciting and growing industry.
Job Description
Summary
Ares is seeking a Quantitative Product lead to help define and deliver the product strategy for quantitative investment technology across the firm's global investment platform.
The role sits within Investment Technology Product Management and serves as the product liaison to Ares' global quantitative teams, including Ares' Quantitative Research teams, recognizing that these teams have distinct investment objectives, research methods, tooling requirements, and coverage across a diverse universe of assets, funds, portfolios, and other securities.
In addition to supporting the quant groups directly, the role will act as a catalyst for extending relevant quantitative tools, techniques, data practices, and analytical capabilities into other Ares asset classes and business lines. The individual will identify where proven approaches can be adapted and scaled horizontally, helping embed the quant teams more deeply into the wider organization and increasing the contribution of these functions to investment decision-making across the firm.
The Quantitative Product lead will own product activities from workflow discovery and use-case definition through prioritization, solution design, delivery, adoption, and value realization. The role will assess the process, data, model, and application landscape; distinguish common capabilities from strategy-specific requirements; and determine when solutions should be built, bought, reused, or adapted across teams.
The successful candidate will combine strong product judgment with sufficient quantitative and technical depth to understand models, data dependencies, investment context, and to work effectively with quantitative engineers and investment professionals.
Primary Functions & Responsibilities
Quantitative Product Strategy & Roadmap
•
Define and maintain the product strategy and roadmap for quantitative investment capabilities, aligned with business priorities and the broader Investment Technology architecture.
•
Translate the distinct objectives of Quantitative groups into sequenced product themes, clear outcomes, and an appropriate balance of shared and strategy-specific capabilities.
•
Make evidence-based build, buy, reuse, adapt, and retire recommendations in partnership with investment teams, engineering, architecture, and Data & AI.
Workflow Discovery & Use-Case Development
•
Map end-to-end workflows across research, data acquisition, signal generation, scenario analysis, portfolio construction, execution support, monitoring, and performance feedback.
•
Develop well-structured use cases and product requirements covering the decision supported, users, data, value, risks, dependencies, controls, and adoption path.
•
Prioritize opportunities through the firm's intake process based on strategic alignment, value, scalability, technical and data readiness, risk, and organizational readiness.
Quantitative Domain Development
•
Shape products supporting returns forecasting, liquidity and cash-flow management, hedging and portfolio optimization, risk-adjusted asset allocation, predictive signals, portfolio construction, and monitoring.
•
Define requirements for scalable ingestion and use of private/public company, market, reference, alternative, portfolio, and third-party datasets.
•
Build connections between quantitative teams and the wider firm, enabling knowledge transfer, common standards, and greater reuse of institutional expertise.
Product Delivery, Adoption & Value
•
Champion a user-centric product approach, ensuring quant capabilities are designed around investor workflows and provide measurable improvements to investment decision-making.
•
Partner with Quantitative Engineering and other technology teams to move solutions from hypothesis and pilot into scalable, resilient, and maintainable products/services.
•
Establish adoption plans with business sponsors and define and track measures such as decision-cycle time, research throughput, model or component reuse, forecast quality, adoption, control effectiveness, and business value.
Governance, Partnership & Culture
•
Coordinate with Data & AI, architecture, cyber, infrastructure, risk, operations, legal, compliance, and vendor teams where products depend on shared platforms or require specialist review.
•
Represent quantitative product priorities in Investment Technology, Data & AI, and use-case governance forums, providing transparent rationale for roadmap and investment decisions.
•
Build trusted relationships with investment team members, quantitative engineers, risk professionals, and operations teams across regions.
Education & Qualifications:
•
Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred. Quantitative discipline such as mathematics, statistics, engineering, computer science, economics, operations research, physics, or finance strongly preferred.
•
Relevant professional qualifications such as CFA, FRM, CQF, or equivalent are advantageous but not required.
Experience Required:
•
Demonstrated experience contributing to or owning products and platforms used by investment professionals for research, portfolio construction, risk, forecasting, execution support, or portfolio monitoring.
•
Strong product management capability across discovery, process design, roadmap development, prioritization, requirements, agile delivery, testing, launch, adoption, and measurement.
General Requirements:
•
5-8 years of relevant experience across product management, quantitative investing, investment technology, data products, business analysis, or quantitative engineering within an asset manager, alternative investment firm, investment bank, or financial technology organization.
•
Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to simplify complex quantitative topics for senior stakeholders and make clear recommendations under uncertainty.
•
High degree of ownership, judgment, curiosity, and comfort operating in an evolving global product organization and liaising with quantitative teams that have distinct objectives and working practices.
•
Collaborative and low-ego working style, with the confidence to challenge constructively and drive decisions across multidisciplinary teams.
Reporting Relationships
Global Head of Investment Technology

Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Department Overview
Who are we?
Are you passionate about creating products with real-world impact? Do you believe that comprehensive, user-centric design can address the complex challenges facing public safety today? We develop truly essential, professional tools - from emergency call-taking and dispatch systems to video security solutions, first responder applications and tools for investigation. Join our diverse, AI-forward, multidisciplinary design team and find work partners looking to collaborate and blur the boundaries of traditional design.
Job Description
As a UX Writer / Content Designer at Motorola Solutions, you'll write the words people rely on when seconds matter - the call handler taking a 911/999 call, the police officer checking a plate, or the investigator piecing together a timeline. In our work, clear language isn't a polish layer; it directly impacts how effectively the product performs.
You will work alongside UX Designers, Accessibility Specialists, the Design Systems team, and software partners to make language consistent, clear, and intuitive across our applications and services:
•
Onboarding flows and navigation
•
System states, notifications, and microcopy
•
High-stress error messages read at 3 a.m. mid-incident
Expect to be in Figma early, shaping product decisions rather than labeling them after they are made. Because our products are specialized, you'll spend real time learning the UK public safety domain - how our users actually communicate, which terms are critical, and where plain language serves them better than sector jargon. You don't need to arrive as an expert, but you do need the curiosity to become one.
Responsibilities include:
•
Craft User Experience Copy: Write and refine clear UI text, onboarding flows, navigation, error messages, and microcopy across complex digital products.
•
Define Tone & Standards: Own our product tone of voice and content design guidelines, evolving them as our software suite expands.
•
Early-Stage Partnership: Partner with designers, researchers, and product managers from discovery through launch, entering the process early enough to influence design decisions.
•
Evidence-Based Iteration: Test and refine content using qualitative user research, field feedback, and usability testing.
•
Domain Mastery: Build deep fluency in public safety terminology, making deliberate choices about where domain-specific language belongs.
•
Design System Integration: Contribute language patterns, component copy guidelines, and content standards to our design system.
Basic Requirements
•
Proven Track Record: 5+ years of experience designing product copy/content for complex web and mobile digital products.
•
Product Portfolio: A portfolio demonstrating problem-solving through product copy - showing your design thinking and trade-offs, not just finished strings. (Focused on product interface work, not marketing or copywriting).
•
Design Integration: Strong grounding in user-centred design (UCD) principles and hands-on experience working directly in Figma (or similar tools).
•
Strategic Trade-offs: The judgment to balance user needs, brand voice, and business constraints - and the ability to articulate your choices to stakeholders.
•
Design Systems: Experience contributing content patterns or guidelines to a design system (bonus if you've built the language portion of one yourself).
•
Accessibility & Inclusion: A track record of collaborating with accessibility specialists (WCAG standards) to ensure language is clear and accessible for everyone.

Who are we?
Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 56 countries.
People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down headhunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work / life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Howden.
Role Purpose
The Strategic Data & Analytics team builds the analytical products that support growth across Howden Employee Benefits. We are a business-embedded team that works directly alongside consultants, client directors and project teams, rather than operating within a traditional technology or IT function. Our products are used every day by colleagues across the UK business and by our clients to support better decision-making, solve complex challenges and deliver stronger outcomes.
This role keeps those products working and their users served, contributes to building the next ones, and owns how work moves through the team. You will be the first point of contact for users of our live products, you will own the backlog and the delivery and governance process, and you will build alongside the rest of the team on a defined set of firm-wide analytical products. Our approach is simple: build fewer things, build them fast, and build them once so they can be used many times.
It is also an unusually fast way to acquire breadth. You will work across Python, Shiny, Quarto, git, Azure DevOps, containerised deployment and infrastructure-as-code inside a single small team, on products with real users and a proper development lifecycle, rather than seeing one part of one stack. Where that leads is open. It may be deeper ownership of how our products run and scale, the build and engineering side of the team, or a direction of your own that we have not yet thought of. Howden is an entrepreneurial firm, and in this team growth happens in our daily work, not in an annual review.This is not a software engineering role and it is not an IT role. We are a consulting team that is proficient with technology.
Location is flexible, with home-based or local Howden office-based both available according to preference. The team itself is distributed across home and several Howden offices and works together primarily over Teams rather than in one room. Our closeness to the business is organisational rather than geographic.
Key Accountabilities
• Work directly with consultants and client directors, who are both our users and our route to the business.
• Support our live analytical products and the people who use them: triaging questions, requests and changes, resolving what you can, and scheduling the rest.

• Maintain the documentation, records and evidence that the team’s governance, reporting and assurance obligations require.
• Contribute to the build of new products and to the team’s reusable components, libraries and templates.
• Contribute to the development of the team’s internal delivery and deployment platform.
Skills & Experience
The first question is whether this is the right environment for you.
• You have a consulting mindset and enjoy working across a wide variety of problems.
• You enjoy helping colleagues and senior leaders make better decisions, and you see data, analytics and visualisation as your tools for bringing that about.
• You are the kind of person who finishes things, keeps records straight and does not let an unanswered request sit. The team’s ability to build depends on this role holding the process.
• You support the people around you, in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges. You share what you learn, you would rather have an honest conversation than a comfortable one, and you build your own network across the business. In a small team we succeed together, and nothing we build succeeds unless the business succeeds with it.
• You take ownership of your decisions, your actions and your outputs.
• You are comfortable with uncertainty and speed, and are interested rather than frustrated by new problems with incomplete and ambiguous information.
• You can work in a fast-growing firm where processes, systems and structures are still being brought together, and where parts of the environment are incomplete.
• You are effective in a distributed team. Most of our collaboration, with each other and with the business, happens over Teams, with colleagues you will meet in person occasionally rather than daily. If you do your best work by turning to the person beside you, this will be a difficult environment.
Technical experience:
• Evidence of analytical or data work that other people actually relied on.
• Experience of supporting users of something you or your team built, and of handling the requests and changes that follow.
• Experience maintaining documentation, governance processes and delivery records.
• Working experience of Python, and of some of the rest of our stack or close equivalents: Shiny or another interactive analytical UI framework, Quarto or similar reporting tooling, git, Azure DevOps or another pipeline and work-tracking platform. We expect some of these, not all, and a clear appetite to pick up the remainder quickly.
You must be able to build without AI coding agents. We do not use them for coding. You will read, write, debug and review code yourself, and be able to explain all of it. If any material part of how you work today depends on agent-assisted or “vibe” coding, this is not the role for you, and we would rather you knew that before applying.
Experience of Employee Benefits, Pensions or Insurance is not required.
What do we offer in return?
A career that you define. At Howden, we value diversity – there is no one Howden type. Instead, we’re looking for individuals who share the same values as us:
•
Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new
•
We support each other in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges
•
We are determined to make a positive difference at work and beyond

Experience supporting ASC 740 tax provision processes for international entities.

Ability to work cross-functionally with Accounting, Treasury, FP&A, and Legal.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex tax concepts for non-tax stakeholders.

Desirable Skills

Who we are
Microchip's Caldicot site is responsible for designing and delivering the next generation of advanced electronic module solutions for global technology markets. Some of our markets include medical, automotive, aerospace, and renewable energy. As a Power Module Design Engineer you will be required to research, design, develop and evaluate new packaging concepts, prototypes and products of the company’s next generation microelectronic modules. This position will allow you to become an integral part of a team of specialists in materials, mechanical, electronics and packaging engineers that strive to push the boundaries of conventional microelectronics packaging.  We are looking for an individual with a passion for exploration and breaking down barriers.  If you are a lateral thinker who thrives on challenging the norm, we welcome the opportunity to speak to you.

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced Electrical Design Engineer to lead the electrical design and simulation of Si and SiC power modules. This role focuses on optimizing electrical performance, reliability, and manufacturability, using advanced design and simulation tools.
Main Duties and Responsibilities:
• Design and develop electrical layouts and schematics for Si and SiC power modules
• Perform electrical simulations to analyse circuit behaviour and optimize switching performance.
• Conduct electromagnetic field simulations to minimize parasitic effects and ensure compliance to target module specifications.
• Evaluate thermal performance in conjunction with electrical design
• Select components, including power semiconductors, passive components, and interconnects, to meet performance requirements.
• Optimize designs for electrical efficiency, reliability, and manufacturability.
• Support prototype builds and testing, analysing data to refine designs and improve performance.
• Prepare detailed technical documentation, including schematics, simulation reports, and test plans.
• Take on other engineering duties as required and assigned.
• Travel internationally on occasion as requested.
Requirements/Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related field.
• 3+ years of experience in power module design, particularly with Si and SiC technologies.
• Proficiency in Altium Designer for electrical schematics and layouts.
• Experience with electrical simulation tools such as SPICE and PLECS.
• Experience of electromagnetic simulation tools, such as ANSYS Q3D, ANSYS Maxwell, and thermal analysis tools like ANSYS Icepak.
• Solid understanding of power semiconductor devices and loss mechanisms.
• Familiarity with reliability and quality standards for power modules.
• Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
• Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a multidisciplinary team environment.

B.S. degree or equivalent experience; an advanced degree in computer science, electrical engineering, machine learning, or a related research or technical field is preferred.

8+ years of experience in AI research, AI infrastructure, distributed systems, GPU computing, technical product management, or engineering.
•
Current understanding of frontier AI research, model development, training, post-training, inference, and emerging AI workloads.

Practical understanding of GPU platforms and AI software libraries, including CUDA, CUDA-X, NCCL, PyTorch or JAX, and relevant training or inference systems.

Experience with large-scale GPU clusters, high-speed networking, distributed storage, workload orchestration, performance optimization, and cloud or on-premises infrastructure.

Ability to understand complex model-builder architectures, identify technical bottlenecks, and translate them into actionable engineering and product requirements.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical subjects clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Ability to operate effectively across NVIDIA Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Events, PR, Corporate Development, NVentures, and executive teams.

Hands-on experience with large language models, multimodal models, diffusion or video models, reinforcement learning, agents, world models, robotics, or other frontier workloads.
•
Experience working below the framework layer with CUDA kernels, communication libraries, compilers, memory movement, precision, or performance optimization.

A track record of turning research or infrastructure insights into product requirements, platform improvements, technical integrations, public technical content, or joint customer success.

Strong curiosity, sound technical judgment, and the ability to stay current as the AI landscape evolves.

Ability to thrive in a startup mindset and dynamic environment, adapting quickly to evolving AI landscapes.

Bring your passion, ideas and purpose to life in a company that can truly help you achieve your full potential.

As a Project Engineer, you’ll have opportunity to introduce significant bespoke automated machines and play an initial step in the validation of them. This is more than a job — it’s a chance to grow. You’ll work with state‑of‑the‑art automation technologies alongside an incredibly skilled engineering community spanning projects, process, production, systems, software, R&D, and machine vision. As an analyst on the in Accenture’s SAP Business Group, you will support the build and deployment of the next-generation SAP enterprise AI platform. Working under direction from senior engineers, you will contribute to specific components of the Enterprise AI stack — BTP service configuration, ingestion pipeline runs, extractor job scheduling, and citation validation — on live client engagements. We are looking for experience in the following skills:

Set yourself apart:

• Hands-on use of an LLM API (any provider) in a project or personal context: prompt construction, response parsing, and understanding of why grounding and citation matter for enterprise use.
• Exposure to SAP ECC or S/4HANA internals — data dictionary, transaction codes, configuration tables, or master data structures — even from a functional or testing background.

At Accenture in addition to a competitive basic salary, you will also have an extensive benefits package which includes up to 25 days’ vacation per year, private medical insurance and 3 extra days leave per year for charitable work of your choice!

Job Description
Overview
The HSE Client and Programme Manager provides HSE leadership and support across priority clients, programmes and frameworks. The role may be embedded within a client or project team where needed. It turns client requirements, bid commitments and AtkinsRéalis standards into clear actions from bid and mobilisation through to delivery and close-out. Working with client, programme and HSE leaders, the role builds strong relationships, manages key risks and supports Thrive, psychological safety and continuous improvement.
Your role
Reporting to the Head of Bid and Assurance, you will provide dedicated HSE management where client commitments, mobilisation or programme demands require additional focus. Where needed, you will work as an embedded member of the client or project team, supporting day-to-day delivery while maintaining clear links with AtkinsRéalis HSE leadership. Priorities will be agreed with the relevant HSE Business Partner and client or programme leadership.
• Embed within client or project teams where required, build trusted relationships, understand delivery priorities and agree proportionate HSE support.
• Prepare clear, deliverable HSE bid responses and identify obligations, risks, assumptions, resources and costs before commitments are made.
• Transfer agreed bid commitments into mobilisation plans, controls, reporting arrangements and accountable ownership.
• Develop and maintain programme HSE plans, governance and critical controls, confirming that competent resources are in place before delivery starts.
• Monitor delivery, provide practical direction and coordinate recovery where standards or commitments are at risk.
• Lead risk-based inspections, audits and assurance, maintaining auditable evidence and ensuring actions are closed.
• Set proportionate HSE measures, provide accurate reporting and use data, findings and feedback to drive learning and improvement.
• Promote Thrive, psychological safety, open reporting and constructive challenge while coaching teams and resolving delivery barriers.
About you
Essential
• Chartered Membership of IOSH (CMIOSH), or demonstrable progress towards chartered status with equivalent professional competence.
• HSE delivery experience in infrastructure, engineering, consultancy or another safety-critical environment.
• Experience translating client requirements into bids, plans, mobilisation activities and delivery actions.
• Competence in risk management, inspections, audits, assurance, incident learning and performance reporting.
• Strong knowledge of UK HSE legislation and governance requirements.
• Ability to manage multiple workstreams and work effectively with multidisciplinary teams, clients and limited supervision.
Desirable
• Experience in rail, aviation, defence, highways, energy, water or major infrastructure.
• Experience supporting Principal Designer or Principal Contractor arrangements.
• Experience in an embedded client, alliance, framework or programme role.
• Experience using digital HSE reporting, assurance or action-management systems.
Success measures
• Bid inputs are accurate, timely and translated clearly into mobilisation and delivery.
• Requirements, risks, resources and commitments are identified early and actively managed.
• Clients receive responsive support, agreed actions are completed and feedback demonstrates confidence.
• HSE plans, governance, mobilisation deliverables and critical controls are established and maintained.
• Performance information is reliable, assurance findings are addressed and learning drives improvement.
• Tools, templates and good practice are shared across accounts and programmes to strengthen delivery capability.
Rewards & benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career. Enjoy competitive salaries, employee rewards and a brilliant range of benefits you can tailor to suit your own health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle choices. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And combine our hybrid working culture and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life.

Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

Ready to Take the Next Step in Your Veterinary Career?
We have an exciting Partnership opportunity for a vet to join us in our 24-hour hospital at Medivet Alfreton 24.
This is more than a career move—it's your opportunity to build something meaningful, with the freedom of ownership and the support to help your practice thrive.
Your Practice. Your Future. Your Way.
As a Medivet Partner, you'll become a co-owner of your practice, combining clinical leadership with the opportunity to shape the future of your business. You'll continue doing what you do best—caring for patients, leading your team, and serving your local community—while Medivet provides the commercial, operational, and strategic support needed to help your practice succeed.
This is a genuine partnership, where both you and Medivet are invested in achieving long-term success together.
Why Partner with Medivet?
Easy to Own
With a 10% deposit starting from just £10,000 and a flexible 10-year deferred payment option for the remaining amount, becoming a practice owner is more accessible than ever. There's no need for a bank loan or to put your personal assets at risk.
Easy to Earn
Benefit directly from the success of your practice through profit share and equity growth, giving you genuine uncapped earning potential.
Easy to Grow
You'll have access to dedicated commercial, operational, and strategic support teams, helping you grow and develop your practice—with no management fees.
Easy to Go
Our partnership model includes a guaranteed exit opportunity every two years and clearly defined equity buy-back arrangements, giving you the confidence and flexibility to plan for the future on your terms.
The Opportunity
We are excited to offer a Partnership opportunity at Medivet Alfreton 24.
Location
Medivet Alfreton 24 is on the border of Derbyshire and Nottinghamshire and is an ideal location for access to the M1 to travel up to Sheffield or down to Nottingham. It also has the beautiful peak district within half an hour if you enjoy outdoor activities.
About the Practice
Medivet Alfreton 24 is a highly equipped, multidisciplinary hospital with separate surgical, orthopaedic, dental, and diagnostic imaging facilities. While the facilities are exceptional, it is the collaborative and supportive team culture that truly sets the practice apart, with patient care at the heart of everything they do.
The practice also serves as a key hub for the local Medivet network, providing out-of-hours care through a dedicated team of Night Veterinary Surgeons and supporting surrounding Medivet practices plus non-Medivet practices with emergency services and round the clock Medivet supervision.
This is a perfect combination of a GP and referral-style practice with a wide range of case exposure.
Who We're Looking For
We're looking for a vet who is passionate about leading their own local practice while benefiting from the support, expertise, and resources of the wider Medivet network. This means you can focus on what matters most: your patients, your team, and delivering exceptional clinical care.
You'll be someone who genuinely cares about the difference you make and is excited by the opportunity to build a thriving practice.
You'll be:
• Passionate about delivering outstanding, compassionate veterinary care.
• Committed to creating exceptional experiences for pets and their owners.
• Excited by the prospect of building something of your own—whether independently or in partnership with a colleague or friend.
• Motivated to develop and grow a successful, sustainable practice.
• Eager to inspire, support, and develop a high-performing team.
Previous leadership experience is not essential. What matters most is your ambition, mindset, and desire to make a difference. We'll provide the training, development, and ongoing support to help you become the leader you aspire to be.
Build Your Future with Medivet
If you've ever dreamed of owning a practice, leading your own team, and shaping the future of veterinary care in your community—without going it alone—this could be the opportunity you've been waiting for.
Your Practice. Your Future. Your Partnership.
Please note, we will only accept applications from RCVS registered Veterinary Surgeons for this role.
Please contact partnerships@medivet.co.uk if you would like an informal chat about this position or to find out next steps.

Job Description:
Reports to
Division Controller, with functional alignment to the Segment IT Director (Specialty Products)
Team
Global Infrastructure, IT Operations & Cyber Manager; Data & Business Applications Lead; IT staff in Slovenia and China; MSPs in North America, UK, Italy, Bulgaria and New Zealand
About the role
ITW Appliance is a global manufacturing division of Illinois Tool Works, with 11 sites in 8 countries across Europe, North America, Asia and New Zealand. We are looking for a leader who can turn our data into a real business advantage and lead a lean, international IT organization.
We have already built a Microsoft Fabric data lake using a medallion architecture, with Power BI on top. Your first priority is to own this platform: direct and challenge its design, scale it across the business, and make sure the capability doesn't depend on any single person. You will also lead our ERP standardization on Acumatica.
A dedicated Infrastructure, Operations & Cyber Manager runs day-to-day infrastructure, cybersecurity and our MSPs, and reports to you. Your role there is to govern, prioritize and challenge, not to run it.
What you will own (in priority order)
1. Data platform and analytics
• Own the divisional data platform (Microsoft Fabric lakehouse, medallion layers, Power BI semantic models) and its roadmap.
• Set data architecture principles, data governance, data quality and a standard KPI framework across all sites.
• Direct pipelines and integrations built with Python, SQL and APIs, with enough technical depth to review and challenge design decisions.
• Deliver business use cases: demand forecasting (including machine learning), supply chain and purchasing visibility, and financial and operational KPIs.
• Coach and grow data talent, hire where needed, and keep the platform documented so there is a credible succession plan.
2. ERP and business applications
• Lead the Acumatica rollout and the retirement of legacy ERPs across sites, working with implementation partners.
• Make the ERP the single source of truth for master data and the main data source for the data platform.
3. IT leadership and governance
• Own the IT roadmap, budget and vendor strategy, using ITW's 80/20 approach to focus on what drives growth.
• Govern infrastructure, cyber and MSP performance through the Infrastructure & Cyber Manager, using clear SLAs.
• Lead a small team spread across Europe and Asia, with clear roles and accountability.
What we need from you
Must have
• You have personally designed and delivered a modern data platform (Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, Databricks, Snowflake or similar) with Power BI or an equivalent tool, not only sponsored one.
• Working knowledge of SQL and Python, and of API-based integration.
• Experience integrating ERP data in a manufacturing or industrial company (any mid-market or enterprise ERP, such as Acumatica, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, QAD or Oracle NetSuite).
• Experience leading people, including data specialists, and working directly with business leaders in operations, supply chain and finance.
• Around 10 years in data, BI or IT roles, with at least 5 in a leadership position.
• Fluent English.
Nice to have
• Acumatica or another mid-market cloud ERP.
• Multi-site or international manufacturing experience.
• Microsoft Fabric certifications (DP-600 or DP-700) or data management certification (DAMA CDMP).
• Machine learning for forecasting or planning.
This role is probably not for you if
• Your background is mainly infrastructure, cybersecurity, OT or IT operations.
• You have led data strategy only at sponsor level, without hands-on delivery.
• You are a developer or engineer who doesn't want to lead people and budgets.
What success looks like in the first 12 months
• The Fabric platform is documented and supported by more than one person, with a clear roadmap.
• Standard KPIs are used by division leadership and by all major sites.
• At least one business use case (forecasting or supply chain visibility) is live and delivering value.
• The Acumatica rollout plan is on track and the next sites are moving forward.
• IT roles, SLAs and MSP performance are clear and measured.
Why join us
You will have real ownership and visible impact in a lean division, with the backing of a global industrial group and a Segment IT network of peers across many manufacturing businesses. You will work with modern Microsoft data technology and see the results of your work directly in our plants.

UK 90-110k

Job Description:
Principal Data Architect
London
Permanent
Full time
We make health happen
As the Principal Data Architect, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our organisation by leading the establishment of a robust data architecture to underpin our Data & Analytics Vision and Connected Care Strategy. You will be responsible for driving a significant improvement in our data capability maturity, enabling us to harness the power of data, analytics and AI to enhance our operational efficiency, customer experience, and strategic decision-making. This role will involve close collaboration with cross-functional teams, executive leadership, and external partners.
You will own and govern the strategic principles, reference architecture and roadmaps for data and data technology help us achieve our strategic vision. Working as part of the BGUK Technology and Architecture Office and a member of the Architecture Leadership Team you will collaborate with peers to align our data strategy, architecture, platforms, and principles with those of other domains. You’ll work with Chief Data & Analytics Office to establish the key data and technology architecture components of the Data and Architecture Strategy. And you’ll own our UK Enterprise Data Model and establish the critical data entities.
How you’ll help us make health happen:
• Lead the design, development, and implementation of an enterprise-wide data architecture strategy that aligns with our business goals and supports our data-driven transformation.
• Define and govern data architecture principles, standards, and best practices to ensure consistency, scalability, and security of data assets.
• Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to identify data requirements, create data models, and define data integration and migration strategies.
• Establish data governance practices, including data quality, metadata management, and data lineage, to ensure data accuracy, reliability, and compliance.
• Provide technical leadership in evaluating and selecting data management and data utilisation technologies, tools, and platforms that support our evolving data ecosystem.
• Mentor and guide a team of data architects, data engineers, and data analysts to foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
• Partner with executive leadership to communicate the value of data-driven initiatives, influencing strategic decision-making through actionable insights derived from data analytics.
• Manage key stakeholders – both technical and non-technical, educating and mentoring as we advance on our data journey.
• Propose and execute technical assessments, proofs of concept and value to promote innovation in the data space and inform data strategy.
• Contribute to the overall data strategy and roadmaps by mentoring a team data architects and other data experts to ensure a collaborative approach to solving our data challenges.
Key Skills / Qualifications needed for this role:
• Proven track record of in data architecture, including substantial experience in a leadership role within complex, data-intensive environments.
• Deep understanding of data architecture principles, data modelling, data integration, data governance, and data management technologies.
• Extensive expertise in leading data transformation initiatives, driving cultural change, and promoting a data-driven mindset across the organisation.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively at all levels.

• You understand technical governance and participate in or deliver the assurance of a service.

• Bupa health insurance as a benefit in kind
• An enhanced pension plan and life insurance

Our mission
Our mission is to deliver clean, affordable energy for all. Our Small Modular Reactor (SMR) offers a British solution to a global energy challenge, placing us at the forefront of a once-in-a-generation opportunity and positioning the UK as a future world leader in clean energy technology.
The team
The Power Station Integration team sits at the centre of our plant design, bringing together engineering disciplines to define how the full power station operates as one integrated system, ensuring performance, coherence and optimisation across an innovative and complex product. The team is responsible for defining power station level requirements, capabilities and attributes, and ensuring these are integrated and delivered across the design.
The role
In this context, we are looking for a Grid Code Lead to join our Power Station Integration team to support the delivery of our generic design and future deployment programmes.
As Grid Code Lead within RR SMR, you will have a strong understanding of the UK Grid Code and be responsible for ensuring Grid Code requirements are correctly interpreted and considered throughout the power station design. You will drive plant-level Grid Code compliance activities and support system teams in understanding their requirements, demonstrating compliance and resolving any compliance-related issues.
What we'll need you to do
We'll need you to:
•
Act as a technical expert for UK Grid Code requirements applicable to the RR SMR power station.
•
Interpret Grid Code obligations and ensure communication of their implications to engineering and programme teams.
•
Support multidisciplinary engineering teams in implementing Grid Code requirements within their designs.
•
Work with teams across the organisation to develop and the power station Grid Code requirements baseline and ensure these are captured and flowed down into system and equipment specifications.
•
Support development of compliance matrices, compliance strategies and assessment methodologies.
•
Review and challenge compliance evidence produced by engineering teams and suppliers.

Identify, manage and escalate Grid Code compliance risks, assumptions and issues.
•
Provide specialist input to design reviews, requirements reviews and regulatory submissions.
•
Engage with external organisations, regulators, network operators, customers and technical specialists as required.
•
Support international deployment opportunities by assessing and interpreting country-specific Grid Code requirements and connection obligations.
•
Promote best practice and develop organisational capability in relation to Grid Code compliance.

•
An engineering qualification or equivalent demonstrable experience within electrical engineering, power systems engineering or a related discipline.
•
Strong experience interpreting and applying Grid Code requirements within power generation, energy infrastructure or transmission projects.
•
Experience developing Grid Code compliance strategies, compliance matrices and evidence-based compliance assessments.
•
Proven ability to translate complex technical and regulatory requirements into practical engineering requirements.
•
Experience working across multidisciplinary engineering teams to deliver integrated solutions.

Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills with the ability to influence technical decisions and gain alignment across multiple functions.

Experience reviewing technical studies and design evidence to support compliance claims.

A structured and analytical approach to problem solving, risk management and decision making.
•
Experience in the application of systems engineering including requirement management would be beneficial.
•
Experience engaging with transmission system operators, network operators or regulatory bodies would be advantageous.
•
Knowledge of European Grid Codes, ENTSO-E requirements, and experience supporting customers in Czechia, Sweden or other European countries would be advantageous

We offer flexible and hybrid working arrangements, and this role can be based from any Rolls-Royce SMR location. Regular travel will be required to support stakeholder engagement, partner organisations, collaborative programmes and industry activities across the UK and internationally.

Your impact
Are you ready to make an impact and gain hands-on experience working on real-world projects from day one?
At Leonardo, we’re looking for summer placement students who want to be part of something extraordinary shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety.
Our placements are designed to help you apply your studies in a practical setting, develop your technical skills, and gain valuable insight into how our business operates.
Our Summer Placement Programme
Our role offers you the chance to spend a year with us, working on meaningful projects alongside subject matter experts, within multidisciplinary teams, and across the product lifecycle. You’ll receive coaching and support from a dedicated team to help you achieve both your placement objectives and personal development goals.
During your placement, you will be exposed to tools, technologies and processes. You will be introduced to the software development processes and utilise state-of-the-art methods, technology and tools. You will also gain experience on one or more aspects of the software development lifecycle, which could include; applied research, requirements analysis, design, implementation, integration, and test.
During your placement, we encourage you to spend at least three days each week on site to integrate with your team and maximise your learning experience.
The programme will run from June - August 2027.
What you will do as a Software Engineer Placement
As part of our early careers community, you will work alongside developers and experts in an environment that is both challenging and rewarding.  Your responsibilities will include:
• Gaining experience, applying your knowledge of software engineering as part of a multi-disciplinary Integrated Project Team.
• Developing practical skills in design techniques for products.
• Growing your understanding of the business as well as the software engineering lifecycle.
Skills, Qualifications & Knowledge Required
Qualifications
This is an exciting and challenging Software Engineering opportunity for students currently studying a science-based degree e.g. Software Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics or Electronic Engineering (BSc (Hon) / BEng (Hon) / MEng.) You are expected to have an appropriate gap in studies.
• Be enthusiastic and passionate about designing software and writing code with experience of doing this from education or outside interests.
• You will have some experience of computer programming
• Have some experience of an object-oriented programming language such as Java, C++, C# or JavaScript and knowledge of UML (Unified Modelling Language) is an advantage but not essential
• A full statement of courses and projects studied at university and corresponding grades/marks/percentage should be included in your CV
• Applications are also welcomed from candidates who have completed a first degree and are looking to gain industrial experience prior to commencing a relevant higher degree (i.e. PhD, MSc)
Security Clearance
At Leonardo, many of our roles are subject to security and export control restrictions set by UK Government Security requirements and customer obligations.  As a result, and in line with the UK Government Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) requirements, all successful applicants will be asked to provide evidence of identity, eligibility to work in the UK, criminal record declaration information and employment and/or education history verification for the previous five years.
For staff operating in more sensitive posts, there is an additional range of personnel security controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV).  As part of this process, a range of factors may be considered, including an individual's background, travel history, nationality, previous nationalities held and other information relevant to the vetting assessment.
To be eligible for National Security Vetting at SC level, applicants will generally be expected to have continuously resided in the UK for the previous five years. For DV clearance, this is typically ten years.  In some circumstances, time spent overseas may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.
Additional vetting requirements may apply upon appointment.
For more information and guidance please visit: https://careers.uk.leonardo.com/gb/en/security-and-vetting
Why join us
At Leonardo, our people are at the heart of everything we do, key contributors in shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety.
We offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports your wellbeing, learning and development, and work–life balance:
• Time to recharge: Our employees are entitled 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays. As a Summer Placement student you will receive this allowance pro rata.
• Secure your future: Award-winning pension scheme with up to 15% employer contribution
• Your wellbeing matters: Free access to mental health support, financial advice, and employee-led networks championing inclusion and diversity (Enable, Pride, Equalise, Armed Forces, Carers, Wellbeing and Ethnicity)
• Never stop learning: Free access to 4,000+ online courses via Coursera and LinkedIn learning.
For a full list of our company benefits please visit: https://careers.uk.leonardo.com/gb/en/company-benefits
We are committed to building an inclusive, accessible, and welcoming workplace. We believe that a diverse workforce sparks creativity, drives innovation, and leads to better outcomes for our people, communities, and customers. If you have any accessibility requirements to support you during the recruitment process, just let us know.
Be part of something extraordinary – Apply now!

GB - Basildon
Contract Type:
Fixed term
Hybrid Working:

kla.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/search/job/new.description_excerpt:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
Group/Division
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The SPTS division provides advanced wafer processing solutions—including etch, deposition and vapor-based technologies—designed for R&D through high-volume production. With a global presence and strong customer support network, SPTS helps manufacturers across industries improve performance, yield and cost-efficiency. It also offers comprehensive service and spare parts through a worldwide network of service centers and qualified local agents.
What You'll Do
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
This is an exciting new role that allows a candidate to work in new technologies and to be involved in many different and new projects.
As the successful candidate, you will be an experienced multidisciplinary Engineer with an understanding of electrical, electronic and mechanical systems. You will be able to build a solid expertise in overall system operation, integration, and calibrations/diagnostics. You will have a hands-on approach by learning from the engineering team to support Alpha & Beta Systems and retrofits.
You would be working with other specialists in the group with equipment design/integration and expect to work to tight deadlines in a highly regulated industry.
Key Responsibilities:
• Maintaining, developing, and improving PVD semiconductor process equipment hardware.
• Building and fault finding in new designs in the factory as part of our PLC process
• Installation and fault finding of new products at customer sites
• Reporting back to the factory on improvements and customer requirements.
• Improve serviceability of new designs
• Testing and compliance of machines to international standards
• Technical report writing
• Planning and executing hardware testing, validation, and performance characterisation.
• Working with process engineers to optimise hardware performance for reliability and process capability.
• Supporting technology development programmes from early concept through to customer-ready
Key Skills required:
• A flexible work ethic and ability to use initiative
• Good analytical and fault-finding skills
• Experience in diagnosing faults and an analytical mind
• Able to work both autonomously and as part of a team
• Well organised – You’ll work autonomously, often in different time zones and be trusted to work without assistance or management.
• Composed – You’ll thrive in the sometimes-pressurised environment of semiconductor manufacturing environments.
• Able to demonstrate strong Communication skills – You’ll enjoy establishing and maintaining good working relationships with both customers and colleagues.
• Driving license
Candidates must be willing to travel internationally ~ 50%, often travelling to customers to assist with problems. We will seek to give as much notice as possible for travel, but trips may be at very short notice and can be for extended periods of time. KLA will of course, provide travel expenses and accommodation, in line with our travel policy.
Occasional domestic and international travel, including to the United States, may be required as part of this role
Qualifications and Experience:
• Minimum HNC Electrical/ Mechanical/ Mechatronics or related field and experience in a customer facing role
What we will offer you?
KLA’s benefits package includes:
Annual leave starting at 25 days (plus bank holidays), contributory pension scheme, cash health plan, cycle to work scheme, global bonus plan, share scheme, rewards scheme, life assurance.
Minimum Qualifications
Minimum HNC Electrical/ Mechanical/ Mechatronics or related field and experience in a customer facing role
About KLA
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.
Use of AI Statement
At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.
We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.
KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Financial & Matter Management

When you work at Clyde & Co, you join a team of 500 partners, 2,400 lawyers, 3,200 legal professionals and 5,500 people in nearly 70 offices and associated offices worldwide. Our values are the principles that guide the decisions we make, unite us in our endeavours and strengthen our delivery, for both our clients and our firm. Job Description:
Kitchen Assistant
Freelands Croft Care Home
Redfields Lane, Church Crookham, Fleet, GU52 0RB
CQC rating: Good
Carehome.co.uk rating: 9.6/10
Salary : £13.10 - £14.10 per hour depending on experience
Hours : 22 hours per week
We make health happen
Here at Bupa, we support those when they need it the most. Our care homes are dedicated to delivering person-centred care, supporting independence and honouring choice to help our residents live their best lives. Our fantastic Kitchen Team are the magic behind each delicious dish we serve our guests. They are passionate about all things food and take great pride in each dish they prepare. We are looking for an equally passionate Kitchen Assistant to join the team and help deliver an excellent dining experience for our residents.
You’ll help us make health happen by:
•
Acting as the link between the main kitchen and our residents
•
Assisting the chefs to plate meals, prepare food trolleys and ensure all preparation areas are kept clean and tidy
•
Monitoring stock rotation, complying to company policies and procedures following all mandatory COSHH and HACPP guidelines
•
Assisting with catering for special events such as summer BBQs and Christmas parties
Key Skills / Qualifications needed for this role:
A passion for food with previous experience working in a kitchen and a Basic Food Hygiene Certificate. You want to deliver an excellent service at each meal and make our residents feel at home. You’ll understand the importance of maintaining high standards in and around the home, ensuring our residents enjoy a pleasant dining experience. Working with the wider kitchen and care home teams - you’re comfortable communicating with others, cherishing the little moments with our residents.
Benefits
Our benefits are designed to make health happen for our people. Viva is our global wellbeing programme and includes all aspects of our health – from mental and physical, to financial, social and environmental wellbeing. We support flexible working and have a range of family friendly benefits.
Joining Bupa in this role you will receive the following benefits and more:
•
My Healthcare - Free access to 24/7 support, advice, and treatment for a variety of health-related issues, including remote GP appointments, physiotherapy and mental health support
•
Annual allowance which you can redeem against a menu of Bupa healthcare products, all to the approximate value of £350
•
Wagestream - Have early access to up to 40% of your earned wages within minutes
•
28 days holiday
•
We offer a sick pay scheme to our frontline teams, as an addition to statutory sick pay, to help provide some reassurance and financial support during longer absences.
•
Long service - For every milestone at Bupa we will reward you with ecards, extra holidays and money!
•
Free meal on every shift
•
Interest-free annual travel loan to enable the purchase of public transport annual season tickets
•
We offer a range of Bupa pension plans – find out more on our career site
•
Parental leave - We have schemes for adoption, birth parents and co parents -find out more on our career site
•
Menopause Plan - Specifically designed to empower women to seek advice, choose their treatment and take control of their health
•
Access to discounts at a wide variety of gyms and fitness facilities across the UK
Why Bupa?
We’re a health insurer and provider. With no shareholders, our customers are our focus. Our people are all driven by the same purpose – helping people live longer, healthier, happier lives and making a better world. We make health happen by being brave, caring and responsible in everything we do.
We encourage all of our people to “Be you at Bupa”, we champion diversity, and we understand the importance of our people representing the communities and customers we serve.  That’s why we especially encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
Bupa is a Level 2 Disability Confident Employer. This means we aim to offer an interview/assessment to every disabled applicant who meets the minimum criteria for the role. We’ll make sure you are treated fairly and offer reasonable adjustments as part of our recruitment process to anyone that needs them.
** Please note, this role is not at or above RQF Level 3 and is not included under the UK's Points Based Immigration System for sponsorship by an employer.
